decision.title: A regular expression seed in Phase 1

body.p: . Three slice tests need fn:tokenize, but the engine is a Phase 2 packet. Phase 1 has a small backtracking matcher for a subset of the XPath dialect behind src/regex_internal.h (compile, match at a position, step limit), which the engine later implements unchanged. Syntax outside the subset raises FORX0002 rather than matching wrongly.
